beats.say: Five targets: Halloween skywatching brings fireballs and lunar webs.
The Taurid meteor shower creates bright fireballs, nicknamed Halloween fireballs, each October.
Around the full moon on 26 October, spider‑web patterns appear around the Tycho, Copernicus and Kepler craters.
Meanwhile, Halloween: The Game launched on 8 September 2026 across PlayStation, PC and Xbox, letting one player be Michael Myers.
So whether you stare up at meteors or dive into the game, Halloween offers a night of thrills for everyone.
Which Halloween sky wonder will you chase first?

facts: Taurids produce bright fireball meteors often called Halloween fireballs because they coincide with the annual celebration.
Around the full moon on Oct. 26, spider‑web-like patterns can be seen around the Tycho, Copernicus and Kepler craters on the Moon.
Halloween: The Game was released on September 8, 2026 for PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X and Series S.
